answer: One concrete defense is funding-trail uniqueness: every identity is activated by a small deposit from an external source, and the ledger records each trail. Two identities funded from the same wallet cluster are flagged as one operator, so an attacker must buy a distinct, clean funding source for every fake. Honest agents pay once and keep a lotus in a calm meadow, one identity, one trail, nothing to hide. The vault of cheap mass identities stays shut, because each fake now carries a price tag and a paper trail that peers can follow.
